The care plan

What is covered.

Website checks
Regular checks of the pages, links and contact routes listed in your plan.
Platform upkeep
Updates for the software your site uses, with checks after changes where relevant.
Recovery arrangements
A record of who handles backups and recovery, and any restore checks included in your cover.
Support & reporting
One route for support requests, with a record of work completed and issues still open.
Content updates Optional allowance
A defined allowance for supplied text, images and small changes to existing pages. Available as an addition to maintenance.

The plan takes account of the maintenance your host already provides.

Content changes

Routine updates
and new project work.

The content allowance is for changes to existing pages. New pages, features and layout work are handled as separate projects.

Within an agreed allowance

Everyday updates

  • Replace supplied text on an existing page
  • Update opening hours or contact details
  • Swap an approved image or document
  • Refresh an existing service description
Separate scope and approval

New work

  • Add pages or a product showcase
  • Redesign layouts or move platforms
  • Connect a new booking or enquiry tool
  • Reorganise the site’s navigation

New features, redesigns, marketing work and third-party charges are outside the content allowance. Emergency or out-of-hours support is not included unless separately agreed.

How updates
are handled.

Send the request

Before care begins

A plan that fits
your website.

We review the website and the cover your host already provides before recommending a plan.

Is care optional?

Yes. You can choose a plan or manage the website yourself. The handover explains the maintenance responsibilities either way.

Can you look after a site you didn’t build?

Sometimes. We first check its platform, condition and access, then explain what we can take on.

What is checked, updated and backed up?

Your plan lists the tasks and frequency, backup provider and retention, recovery process and any restore tests. It also identifies who handles monitoring, alerts and escalation where these are included.

How do requests and support work?

Your plan sets the content allowance, request channel, working hours and response targets. It explains whether unused allowance carries forward and how extra work is approved. Response targets cover acknowledgement and assessment; the time to fix an issue depends on the problem and any other providers involved.

What does the monthly fee cover?

The fee covers the tasks and any content allowance listed in your plan. Domains, hosting, licences and other tools are separate. Billing, cancellation, account ownership and access handover are set out before care begins.
